Reads JSON export files and writes server + client INI files

summary: Created src/Tools/TranslationImporter.php with private constructor, create() factory, and static run() Composer entry point
Implemented 3-step config resolution (const → env → default path) identical to TranslationExporter
getUniqueSources() deduplicates by alias|realpath(storageFolder) to handle multiple registrations of the same physical source
importLocaleSource() reads JSON, validates format_version===1, builds hash→translation map via buildTranslationMap()
buildTranslationMap() skips empty translations and warns on stale hashes not found in current StringCollection
writeIniFiles() writes server INI (makeEditable=true) and client INI (makeEditable=false, JS-only strings) via LocalizationWriter
Uses JavaScriptLanguage::LANGUAGE_ID constant for correct 'JavaScript' case in client filter
normalizeFolder() uses realpath() with forward-slash fallback for cross-platform path normalisation
Added import-translations Composer script to composer.json
Verified: imports 121/128 de_DE + fr_FR application-localization strings; INI files written correctly; PHPStan level 8 clean; 95 tests pass

comments.note: No observations — code is clean and consistent with TranslationExporter patterns. JavaScriptLanguage::LANGUAGE_ID constant used correctly (capital J capital S); existing save() bug with 'Javascript' is not in scope of this WP.

summary: composer import-translations imports 121/128 de_DE strings and 121/128 fr_FR strings for application-localization source; 143/171 and 165/171 for application-utils source
Server INI contains all translated strings; client INI contains JS-only subset (empty for application-localization which has no JS strings — correct)
Missing JSON file triggers WARNING message and processing continues with remaining sources — verified by temporarily removing de_DE JSON file
Empty-translation skip is implemented in buildTranslationMap() via translation === '' check
Stale hash warning implemented in buildTranslationMap() via collection->hashExists() guard
PHPStan level 8 clean; 95 tests pass with 0 regressions

comments.note: application-localization source has no JavaScript-language strings, so client INI is empty except for header — this is correct and expected behaviour.

summary: TranslationImporter follows identical structural patterns to TranslationExporter (private constructor, create() factory, 3-step loadConfig(), dedup getUniqueSources(), normalizeFolder())
All public/private method signatures are fully type-annotated; PHPStan level 8 confirms no issues
JSON validation is thorough: format_version check, is_array guard on strings array, graceful file-not-found and parse-error paths
LocalizationWriter is used correctly per existing codebase: makeEditable() on server INI only; JavaScriptLanguage::LANGUAGE_ID constant used (not string literal)
No magic strings for INI file naming — patterns match existing {locale}-{alias}-server.ini / client.ini conventions
Two low-priority improvement observations noted (DRY extraction candidate if a third tool ever arrives; writeIniFiles source param narrowing)

comments.note: loadConfig() / getUniqueSources() / normalizeFolder() are direct copies from TranslationExporter. Acceptable at this scale, but these shared helpers are a candidate for extraction into a shared BaseTranslationTool class if a third tool is ever added.
writeIniFiles() accepts BaseLocalizationSource but only uses getAlias(). Could narrow to string $alias. Not a bug; matches TranslationExporter style and keeps the interface readable.
